title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
source: AUD mC> Rx2> DAT> CDR; this new version has been pitch adjusted with the following ratios: acoustic set with a 'slight' sliding time scale/pitch shift of +0.123%; 2) electric set with a sliding time scale/pitch shift of +9.678%; (electric [lower volume level] set has also been amplified by +3.9%)

ai_review.summary: Stunning matrix mix of an iconic acoustic/electric show featuring the first Ripple and Broke Down Palace recordings, with crystal‑clear sound and priceless audience ambience.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this version, praising the historic setlist that showcases the band’s evolving repertoire and highlighting the first recorded performances of "Ripple" and "Broke Down Palace." The recording delivers excellent clarity—direct acoustic tones and a seven‑channel enhanced electric mix—while preserving the audience atmosphere, making it a top‑tier listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews award five stars and emphasize outstanding musical performance and superb recording quality; the weighting of show (70%) and recording (30%) yields a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix with direct acoustic settings and enhanced seven‑channel electric; audience ambience retained for atmosphere, no reported muddiness or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the set as a gift from the gods, noting the seamless blending of acoustic and electric material and the band's ability to cover divergent songs with depth.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his versatility—playing three bands on three instruments throughout the show.
